scene: Inside the rattling mail train, pneumatic tubes hiss above velvet passenger seats.
beats: You snatch the fluttering letter, but it nips your thumb and flutters toward the sliding doors as the train halts at Lost Property Depot.
The badger nods wisely and slips a velvet key into your palm just as the brakes hiss and the Depot doors slide wide.
Warm lavender steam billows from the pipe, soothing the rattling carriage as it glides to a stop and the doors part at the Depot.
picture: Flat side view inside the mail carriage. At far left, a winged envelope hovers. On the left, a badger in a vest sorts mail. Centre stands the player in his orange jacket and beanie. Up high, overhead pipes feature a brass valve. On the right, windows show receding rooftops.
shown: a fluttering parcel with tiny feather wings, mid-air at the far left
a dapper badger postal clerk sorting cartas at a desk on the left
a gleaming pressure valve attached to overhead copper pipes up high

after.label: Step off at Lost Property Depot
Stay on
after.beat: You stay put as the Depot slips away, watching telegraph poles whizz past until the line ends. Hitching a ride on a friendly tow truck, you pull up outside the buzzing, colourful Neon Sign Hospital.
after.then: Step off at Neon Sign Hospital
